In detail

Nottinghamshire Police recorded 816 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 12.5 per 1,000 residents, the 9th highest rate of Nottingham's 20 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (61), vehicle crime (21), burglary (9); the evening/night score by violent crime (80), anti social behaviour (19), public order (16). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Lenton & Wollaton East safe?

Wandroz currently rates Lenton & Wollaton East in Nottingham as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Nottingham during the day and relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Nottingham at night. This rating is derived from Nottinghamshire Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Lenton & Wollaton East safe at night?

At night, Lenton & Wollaton East is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Nottingham. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Lenton & Wollaton East a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Lenton & Wollaton East's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Nottingham) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
